Hyx has been consumed. Do not under any circumstance go here. It is watching. It will not rest until it's done. Never. Go. Here.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Assimilated.

CONDITIONS: Watched.

FAUNA: The Overseer is here.

> Environment

Hyx has been completely assimilated by The Overseer, who can be seen floating above the moon looking down on players and moving as time progresses. The terrain is made up of yellow ish rocks, strange rock formations, a goopy red substance, and large craters scattered around the landscape. The goopy red substance is also part of the waterfall, river, and lakes and functions as quicksand. The south portion and end of the river has this quicksand trigger above the red goop, causing players to sink through the solid ground on the shoreline.

A forested area can also be found in the west portion of the moon, which is connected to the rest of the exterior by bridges. The trees have tendril-like growth coming out of them. The main entrance can be found west and slightly north of the ship in the forest, surrounded by strange glowing rocks. Three other buildings and fire exits can be found in the forest southwest, northwest, and north and slightly west of the ship. The last fire exit can be found southeast of the ship.

In Hyx's interior, several creatures and body parts can be found completely assimilated. They can be collected as scrap.

Hyx's Ambience

Hyx plays ambience in the background while on the exterior. The Overseer can also be heard on the exterior and in the interior.

Exterior Ambience

Overseer Ambience


> Weather

Hyx can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, or Earthquakes weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

The Overseer in the distance.

The Overseer

The Overseer can hear and feel players while they are on Hyx, progressively getting angrier as the day progresses and while players are running, using a jetpack, etc., on the exterior. Each time The Overseer is angered, he will roar and several tentacles will appear on the exterior.

Addtionally, The Overseer can randomly unleash colossal tentacles from the large craters of a red substance. These tentacles will target and track a player before slamming down. These tentacles have a hitbox on the bottom and top ends of the tentacle, making a portion of the center of the tentacle safe. Any player that comes into contact with these hitboxes will take 999 damage per hit. Excluding the ship, these tentacles can damage players through obstructions.

Assimilation

Hyx's interior has several hazards that mostly aid in Hyx's primary gimmick, Assimilation. This is functionally similar to Cadaver Growth Infection, but it takes significantly longer at a baseline for Assimilation progress to reach 100%. Getting hit by most of Hyx's hazards also increases Assimilation progress significantly. Any player that does reach 100% Assimilation progress will shortly die and spawn an Assimilated Employeee, a variant of the Cadaver Bloom with 28hp that similarly only takes 1 damage from all sources.

For a list of interior hazards:

  • An Assimilated Growth will immediately spawn in the interior upon landing. It is a variant of the Cadaver Growth that can not be destroyed and builds up Assimilation (infection) at a comparatively much slower rate.
  • Sets of three tendrils coming out of a red substance and yellowish rock on the ground, dealing 15 damage per hit to players and building up Assimilation.
  • Tentacles coming out of the floor, ceiling, and walls from yellowish rocks that deal 20 damage per hit to players that come into contact with them and build up Assimilation.
  • Markings that look similar to a red X on yellowish rocks will lash out with tendrils when a player walks near them, dealing 15 damage per hit and building up Assimilation. These can deal upwards of 90 damage if a player stands in them for the full duration they're active.
  • A small red circle on yellowish rocks will lash out with a tentacle and scan around the area when a player is near it, dealing 20 damage per hit. This hazard does not build up Assimilation on its own but does decrease player hp to speed up its progress.
  • A red subtance will periodically fall from yellowish rocks on the ceiling to the floor. This substance deals 1 damage per hit to players and builds up Assimilation.

> Lore

Hyx was originally advertised as a vacation destination to experience the wonders of nature. It has since been entirely "assimilated" by The Overseer, a cosmic entity and the primary antagonist of Wesley's Moons.

Hyxellia Logs

These logs can be found by interacting with five Databoxes on the exterior. In order of the log number, these can be found at the main entrance, at the fire exit southeast of the ship, at the fire exit north and slightly west of the ship in the forest, southwest of the ship in the forest near one of the fire exits, and northeast of the ship near a lake. They document the full timeline of the moon's assimilation.

The Beginning

The Beginning - 0 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
In the town of Rosemaw, a small hike into the forest a meteor fragment had impacted.
It is not unusual for small fragments to reach the surface and make contact so it wasn’t immediately reported by the public.

A few days later a few hikers had noticed an unusual looking fungus but chose to leave it be. These hikers only began to take notice once it started spreading and growing over a small patch in the forest. They didn’t think much of it and avoided the area for the time being.

The Employee

The Employee - 4 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
Richard Pollar, more commonly known as Rich, arrived at the local bakery for work an hour before opening time. He started preparing the kitchen for the day, organising and cleaning the kitchen when he noticed red blobs of an unusual liquid sticking to the equipment and the furniture.
The liquid was thick and lukewarm to the touch, a gooey substance. Rich was both intrigued and disgusted by the discovery and went looking for the source. He couldn’t find anything else out of the ordinary until he got to the stove. He was frightened by what he saw. It was a rat covered in tendrils with strange goop oozing from one of its empty eyesockets, bubbling and twitching as it did. Before Rich could fully understand what he was looking at, it scurried away, fleeing to someplace outside.
He was shaking and frantically called his employer before loosely explaining what happened.
Rich was quickly dismissed with the assumption of it being another one of his psychotic breaks.
Meaning to prove that what he witnessed was real, he went to chase it down, leaving a note for the other employees explaining where he went.
Rich followed the trail of goop through the town, into the forest all the way to the area where the fungus was spotted by hikers before. There he found it, laying still on this yellow-orangish rock. Rich was bemused and stared at it for a while. He assumed it was dead considering its state and the fact it wasn’t moving anymore. The only movement he saw were these small tendrils sticking out of its body.
Unsure of what to make of it he decided to investigate, he was scared but his curiosity carried him forward. The fungus he had heard about has seemingly spread through a significant chunk of the forest.
As Rich wandered through the infested area, he laid eyes upon more of these critters in a similar condition. Witnessing this he got scared and ran back towards the bakery and told his coworkers, who had arrived by this time, what he had seen. To ensure they would believe him he had taken some pictures to show.
The coworkers seemed very concerned upon being shown the pictures. Similarly confused and disgusted they decided to investigate on their own, leaving Rich at the bakery, who at this time was still shaking.
An hour passed and Rich grew concerned, maybe they got lost, maybe they were still investigating, who knows. But he grew more and more concerned by the minute. Another hour later he finally made the decision to call the authorities. Fearing they’d dismiss him if he spoke the truth, he only said there was an emergency at the bakery. And there he stayed until an officer arrived.

The Officer

The Officer - 4 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
An officer by the name of Michael Benson, Mike for short. Arrived at the scene finding a distressed Richard sitting in the bakery. Mike asked about the emergency to which Rich tried to explain that his coworkers left to investigate something in the forest but hadn’t returned for hours. Mike grew suspicious and calmly asked why he’s as distressed as he is. Rich told Mike there’s horrifying things happening in the forest around the infested area.
Mike called this in and went to have a look for himself, unsure if he was telling the truth. But only after a few more officers arrived at the scene.
Mike arrived at the forest and cautiously took a few steps in when he already began to see signs of something being off.
The ground was covered in yellowish rock with this red substance oozing out of the ground. Slightly deeper into the forest, plants seemed to turn gray, die or get covered in this same yellow rock.
Mike returned to the edge of the forest and called for a search party. This has to be reported, it has become a real anomaly he thought. Half an hour later four more officers arrived and the search started.
As Mike ventured deeper into the forest he began to see the same things Rich had described, Critters, seemingly deceased with tendrils erupting from their bodies. Starting to get a notion of dread he continued. As he stumbled further into the woods it became less and less lively.
Then he noticed something red, moving away from him, sliding across the rocky ground, leaving a trail of that same red substance. As Mike got closer the picture got clearer, it was similar to the critters he had seen earlier. When he walked in a big circle to the front of it he saw what it really was.
It was the front half of a moose, a large tentacle slid out of its mouth alongside a significant amount of red ooze. Where its back half was meant to be was nothing but tendrils and intestine slowly moving it forward.
Frightened, Mike quickly stepped back. He wasn’t sure what to do. It looked like it was trying to scream or yell but no sound erupted from its mouth. Another tentacle protruded through one of its eyes, pushing it out of its socket followed by blood and ooze.
Now horrified, Mike grabbed the weapon out of his holster and fired a bullet into its head, meaning to end its suffering.
It ceased to move for a moment but quickly got back to it, now oozing from the wound.
Mike was filled with dread and ran away from there. On his way back he found something else.
The missing employees laid there, lifeless on the hard rock surface. He called it in and told the other officers to head back. The employees were in a terrible condition, it looked like their limbs had torn themselves from their bodies, oozing out of their eyes and mouths. Witnessing this he ran back immediately and met up with the other officers in the bakery. This has quickly turned into a seemingly deadly fungal invasion.

The I.T.D.A.

> The I.T.D.A.
The Coverup
—--------------------------------------
[This a detailed construction of events put together through interviews and reports with those involved]

The I.T.D.A. - 7 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
The town has been evacuated and all survivors involved have been brought in for questioning and isolation. The I.T.D.A. Has labeled this situation as critical and has begun quarantining the area. Nobody was allowed to enter or leave the quarantine zone. The military had been called in for additional security.
Several teams of experienced biologists and scientists had made it to the site to analyze and halt the anomalous threat. It was immediately proven not to be any sort of fungi but something else that had yet to be documented. This spread seemed to overtake whatever they put in front of it, consuming it entirely. Attempts of halting the spread were made such as burning it which only temporarily made the tendrils disappear. They had attempted several other chemical solutions to no avail. The closest they had gotten was by using a liquid which super freezes anything it comes into contact with. It only significantly slowed it down.
From this point several nearby towns were also evacuated as the spread and the quarantine area grew. Slowly but surely the area was becoming a wasteland.
It was discovered that direct contact with the substance could result in an infection which ends in a grueling eruption of tendrils, torn limbs and death.
The I.T.D.A. had officially labeled the spread as a world-ending level hazard. And as there have been no viable methods to halt the spreading or cure anyone infected. The I.T.D.A after a discussion with the Council of Rule on Calist, had marked Hyxellia as a moon in quarantine. Nobody could enter. Nobody could leave. Those who tried were either stopped or killed.
The population remaining on Hyxellia were scared, unable to send out or receive communication from a source outside of the moon, the only source they had were the I.T.D.A. which assured the public that the threat will be dealt with.
Biologists had well documented the workings of this spread which has gained the name “The Red Death”. In a detailed report it was documented how the red death consumed and spread:
The yellow rock-like material isn’t technically stone as many assumed but more similar to a very thick, dense, solidified skin. Instead of being stretchy, the density makes it much harder and rock-like. Below the yellow crust is a much softer meat-like material, this material is able to retract or expand, even move as if it’s one large living being organising its fleshy layer. This soft layer has seen to form these tentacles or tendrils for either defensive or even offensive measures. The spread itself is quite unique, these cells will attempt to eat whatever is around them and immediately replace the consumed material with a new cell. The process of consumption also generates this red substance. Drilling procedures have noted that deep inside the soft layer there’s large tunnels where the substance flows similar to our veins. The substance which gets generated doesn’t always end up within these veins, it often surfaces and forms large bubbles of goop below the crust, sometimes bursting through, leaving holes within the crust and forming large puddles of goop.
At the two week mark, the Red Death had consumed nearly half the moon. The cause seemed lost. This was the end times. Anyone still on Hyxellia was awaiting a horrible fate with no way of saving them.
Many military personnel as well as teams sent in by the I.T.D.A. have chosen to end their own lives to avoid a worse end.

The Coverup - 16 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
Hyxellia had been nearly entirely consumed and the I.T.D.A. had ceased any further attempts at rescuing the moon.
Following this the I.T.D.A. had sent out a message to Calist, where the council would decide over the fate of the moon.
The response was immediate and due to the level of contagiousness of the Red Death, the council had decided to not only keep the moon in quarantine but also silence anyone aware of the situation.
Hyxellia was to be removed from the star maps and public knowledge entirely as if it had never existed in the first place. They had gone through great lengths to achieve this.
Nearing full corruption, few reports were sent out by biologists in hopes they would be rescued.
They spoke of having heard sounds from deep space, calling them cosmic, possibly a language they couldn’t understand. They said it felt like something was watching them. Something beyond what they could understand. Something they couldn’t feel but only feel its presence of.
In the final moments of life on Hyxellia, a warning was sent out:
“Stay away. It is watching us. It sees us. It will come for us all.”
Hyx is a threat, well documented and hidden.

[These documents have been classified by the Council of Rule]
Under no circumstance can they be released to the public.
They will be kept on Hyxellia to ensure no living being is able to access them.

Translated Messages

Translated Messages can randomly be found as scrap within the interior and are translations of The Overseer talking about its plan and success in using the Emperor as a puppet ruler to cause a war and destabilize the region to continue assimilating worlds unimpeded. Although not mentioned in these logs, the "spark", or catalyst, was the Triton military's destruction of Calist ordered by Agent Geoffrey at the request of the Emperor after the Council of Rule refused to allow the study and usage of biological weapons.

> Trivia

The Region Pillars

The left pillars with the KENJI, SFDESAT, DEMONMAE, STARLANCER, DELTA, GENERIC, and NIKKI REGIONS.
The right Hyx pillars with the WESLEY, S1CKBOY, TOLIAN, LUNAR LIGHTS, ROSIE, V0XX, and HARVEST REGIONS.

Hyx's exterior has a set of stone pillars in the southwestern area of the forest with various regions and moon names inscribed on them. All of these are references to various Lethal Company mod developers and the moons they have created.

  • Kenji, who created the KENJI REGION with the Kenjis Moons modpack containing the moons Taldor, Dejection, Ascension, Lua, Nostalgia, Row, Kiri, Kiln, Hollowed, Manuland, Allure, Thrive, and Alacrity. Wring, Broadkast, Constant, Collide, Checkpoint, Breach, Reposo, Gambit, Hush, and Devotion are not available on Thunderstore and might be unreleased or currently in development.
  • SFDesat, who created the SFDESAT REGION with the moons Aquatis, Celest, and Orion. Development has since been taken over by Tolian.
  • DemonMae, who created the DEMONMAE REGION with the Moons of Otherworldly Oddity modpack containing the moons Halation, Espira, Mazon, Praetor, Rockwell, Calypso, Makron, Lithium, Baykal, and Ultimatum. DemonMae also created the moon Flicker.
  • Audio Knight, who created the STARLANCER REGION with the StarlancerMoons modpack containing the moons Auralis, Triskellion, Solace, and StarlancerZero.
  • JacobG5, who created the DELTA REGION with the moons Pinnacle and Elasticity. Obstruction, Lodge, Fortitude, and Contempt are not available on Thunderstore and might be unreleased or currently in development.
  • Generic_GMD, who created the GENERIC REGION with the Generic Moons modpack with the moons Integrity, Icebound, Landslide, Submersion, Brutality, Incineration, Humidity, Corrosion, Vaporization, Burrow, Deluge, Vertigo, Devestation, Harvest, Collateral, Divide, and Ignition. Hydro is not on the pillar but is present in the modpack, Legacy is the original version of Collateral, and Cordillera was created for Sickboy as part of a secret santa event. Traversal, Monolith, Abomination, Sable, Timorous, Avalanche, Detonation, Damnation, Anchorage, Nucleus, Refuge, Haven, Ruin, Finale, Conduct, Termination, Covenant, Pathogen, Sanctuary, Pallasteroid, Aurora, and Smoulder are not available on Thunderstore and might be unreleased or currently in development.
  • Nikki, who created the NIKKI REGION with the moons Gorgonzola, Sorrow, Carnage, and Carapace.
  • Magic_Wesley, who created the WESLEY REGION with this modpack. This pillar also includes Facto and MorvDonalds.
  • s1ckboy, who created the S1CKBOY REGION with the MythicMoons modpack containing the moons Seichi, Olympus, and Arelion. s1ckboy also created Lurkin, but has stated "consider it deprecated." Kanema is an unreleased moon.
  • Tolian, who created the TOLIAN REGION with the Tolian Moons modpack.
